2.w: “Truly [it is] that you⁺ [are] the people, and wisdom will die with you⁺.

3.w: Also unto me [is] a heart like you⁺; I [am] not falling below you⁺. And with whom are not [things] like these?

4.w: I have become a laughingstock to his neighbor, one calling on God and He answered him, righteous [and] blameless—a laughingstock.

5.w: [There is] contempt for disaster in the thought of the secure, prepared for those slipping of foot.

6.w: The tents of robbers are at rest, and those disturbing God are secure—to the one who carries [his] god in his hand.

7.w: But ask now the beasts, and they will instruct you, and the birds of the heavens, and one will declare to you.

8.w: Or speak to the earth and it will instruct you, and the fish of the sea and they will recount to you.

9.w: Who among all these does not know that the hand of YHWH has done this—

10.w: in whose hand [is] the soul of every living [thing], and the breath of all the flesh of man?

11.w: Does not the ear examine words, and the mouth taste food for itself?

12.w: With the aged is wisdom, and in length of days is understanding.

13.w: With Him [are] wisdom and strength; unto Him [are] counsel and understanding.

14.w: Behold, He tears down, and it cannot be rebuilt; He closes [up] upon a man, and it cannot be opened.

15.w: Behold, He restrains the waters and they dry up, and He sends them forth and they overthrow the land.

16.w: With Him [are] strength and wisdom and unto Him [are] the deceived and the deceiver.

17.w: He leads away counselors barefoot, and judges He makes foolish.

18.w: The bond of kings He loosens, and He binds a waistband around their loins.

19.w: He leads away priests barefoot, and the established He overthrows.

20.w: He deprives the lip of the trusted ones, and the discernment of the elders He takes away.

21.w: He pours out contempt on nobles, and the mighty He makes feeble.

22.w: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings to light the shadow of death.

23.w: He makes great nations, and destroys them; He enlarges nations and guides them away.

24.w: He turns aside the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, and makes them wander in a wilderness without a path.

25.w: They feel [about] [in] darkness without light, and He makes them stagger like a drunkard.
